label: 1. Single-Image Captioning (Coastal Port)
query: Describe the land use and coastal infrastructure in this scene.
why_this_matters_to_isro: Automates maritime domain awareness and port facility monitoring from high-resolution Cartosat/Sentinel imagery without manual analyst annotation.

label: 2. Open-Vocabulary Grounding (Industrial Zone)
query: Locate the large industrial warehouse and any parking lots.
why_this_matters_to_isro: Permits arbitrary natural-language target localisation for infrastructure audits and disaster risk mapping without pre-trained fixed-class detectors.

label: 3. Bi-Temporal Change Detection (LEVIR-CD Urban Expansion)
query: What changed between these two dates? Has new construction occurred?
why_this_matters_to_isro: Provides quantifiable change percentages and visual masks to monitor unauthorized urban encroachment and infrastructure progress across multi-year revisit intervals.

label: 4. Optical + SAR Fusion (Monsoon Flood Inundation)
query: Identify flooded areas despite cloud cover using the paired SAR data.
why_this_matters_to_isro: Crucial for disaster management (NDRF/SAC) where optical sensors are blinded by monsoon overcast but Sentinel-1 / EOS-04 SAR penetrates cloud cover.

label: 5. Built-Up Change Assessment (Multi-Temporal Urban)
query: Has built-up area increased in this region between the two acquisitions?
why_this_matters_to_isro: Enables automated regional reporting on urbanization rates and loss of permeable/agricultural land for national land-use policy.

label: 6. Compound Query (Stretch: Port Activity & Wake Analysis)
query: Count the docked vessels, assess port activity level, and flag any anomalous wake patterns.
why_this_matters_to_isro: Demonstrates multi-hop reasoning by chaining detection, perceptual metrics, and VLM synthesis for complex tactical surveillance.
